g.text: Core Crown components reconcile to total expenses in the 2025 LTFM
Long-term spending pressures extend beyond pensions
Official conditional projection: 2025 LTFM vintage: outturn through 2024, BEFU 2025 forecast to 2029, conditional projection from 2030. Not
an updated PREFU projection. Finance costs reflect accumulated borrowing and interest assumptions; they are not direct expenditure on older
